segments.text: 这根形似小香肠的盲管，就是阑尾。
segments.en: This small sausage-shaped tube is the | appendix.

segments.text: 发起炎来，它可能染上红、黄、黑。
segments.en: When inflamed, it may turn red, yellow, | then black.

segments.text: 每一次颜色流转，都记录着组织的伤痕。
segments.en: These colors reveal how tissue is injured.

segments.text: 循着这抹色彩，我们走进炎症的现场。
segments.en: Follow the colors to understand | inflammation.

segments.text: 病理学里的“变质”，不是食物变坏。
segments.en: In pathology, alteration has a specific | meaning.

segments.text: 先听听身体发出的求救信号。
segments.en: Start with the body's warning signs.

segments.text: 疼痛可能从肚脐周围，移向右下腹。
segments.en: Pain may move from around the navel to the | lower right abdomen.

segments.text: 还可能恶心、发热，右下腹明显压痛。
segments.en: Nausea, fever, and marked lower right | abdominal tenderness may occur.

segments.text: 疼痛若持续加重，别抱着侥幸硬扛。
segments.en: Do not ignore persistent or worsening | pain.

segments.text: 相似的求救声，也可能来自其他腹部疾病。
segments.en: Other abdominal conditions can cause | similar symptoms.

segments.text: 有些人的信号，却并不典型。
segments.en: Some people have atypical symptoms.

segments.text: 医生先循着症状和体格检查寻找线索，
segments.en: Doctors begin with symptoms and physical | examination,

segments.text: 再参考化验，判断是否阑尾炎。
segments.en: then use laboratory results to help assess | appendicitis.

segments.text: CT是重要的辅助确诊工具，
segments.en: CT is an important diagnostic aid.

segments.text: 但并非人人都必须做CT。
segments.en: But not everyone needs a CT scan.

segments.text: 汇总8项研究的荟萃分析显示，
segments.en: A meta-analysis pooling 8 studies found:

segments.text: 增强螺旋CT敏感度95%、特异度94%。[1]
segments.en: For contrast-enhanced helical CT, | sensitivity: 95%; specificity: 94%.

segments.text: 这束影像之光，能帮助发现病变，
segments.en: It can help detect appendicitis.

segments.text: 却仍需结合临床，判断病情轻重。
segments.en: Severity still requires an overall | assessment.

segments.text: 单纯性→化脓性（蜂窝织炎性）→坏疽性
segments.en: Simple → suppurative (phlegmonous) → | gangrenous

segments.text: 是最常见的典型演变，
segments.en: is the most common typical progression,

segments.text: 但并不是每个患者都必经的固定流程。
segments.en: but not every patient follows this fixed | sequence.

segments.text: 第一幕红：单纯性阑尾炎，充血、轻度肿胀。
segments.en: Act I, red: simple appendicitis, | with congestion and mild swelling.

segments.text: 局部血管扩张，血流增多，染出这抹红。
segments.en: Dilated vessels and increased blood flow | cause redness.

segments.text: 血管里的液体和蛋白质渗出，
segments.en: Fluid and proteins leak out of blood | vessels,

segments.text: 积在组织间隙，形成水肿。
segments.en: causing tissue edema and swelling.

segments.text: 巡逻的白细胞游出血管，挺进受损组织。
segments.en: Patrolling white blood cells leave vessels | and advance into injured tissue.

segments.text: 这是身体为抵御损伤，调动的防御。
segments.en: Inflammation is the body's protective | response to injury.

segments.text: 然而战况一旦失控，也可能伤及自身组织。
segments.en: An excessive response can also damage the | body's own tissue.

segments.text: 液体、蛋白质和白细胞外出，叫渗出。
segments.en: These changes are called exudation.

segments.text: 单纯性时，中性粒细胞主要驻守在
segments.en: In simple appendicitis, neutrophils are | mainly found

segments.text: 黏膜及黏膜下层，组织损伤相对较轻。
segments.en: in the mucosa and submucosa, with | relatively mild damage.

segments.text: 变质，就是细胞组织的变性、坏死。
segments.en: Alteration means cell degeneration and | necrosis.

segments.text: 此时，黏膜上皮已局部受损脱落。[2]
segments.en: Mucosal epithelium is locally injured | and shed.

segments.text: CT可见管径增粗、壁增厚，
segments.en: CT may show a wider appendix and a | thickened wall,

segments.text: 周围脂肪轻度模糊，呼应早期的炎症。
segments.en: with mild surrounding fat stranding, | matching early inflammation.

segments.text: 第二幕黄：炎症的战线累及整层阑尾壁。
segments.en: Act II, yellow: inflammation involves | the full appendiceal wall.

segments.text: 这是化脓性，也叫蜂窝织炎性阑尾炎。
segments.en: Suppurative (phlegmonous) appendicitis.

segments.text: 中性粒细胞纷纷涌入，部分变性坏死。
segments.en: Many neutrophils enter; some degenerate | and die.

segments.text: 脓液中，还混着组织碎屑与渗出的液体。
segments.en: Pus also contains tissue debris and exuded | fluid.

segments.text: 渗出愈明显，局部肿胀往往愈突出。
segments.en: More pronounced exudation often means | greater swelling.

segments.text: 变性坏死的中性粒细胞，就是脓细胞。
segments.en: These degenerated, necrotic neutrophils | are pus cells.

segments.text: 渗出的纤维蛋白原凝成纤维素网。
segments.en: Exuded fibrinogen forms a fibrin mesh.

segments.text: 网与脓细胞等交织，形成纤维脓性渗出物。
segments.en: The mesh mixes with pus cells and debris | to form fibrinopurulent exudate.

segments.text: 黄色并非只来自纤维素，更来自大量脓细胞。
segments.en: Yellow comes not only from fibrin, | but also from many pus cells.

segments.text: 浆膜面可见纤维素性脓性渗出（含脓细胞）。
segments.en: Fibrinopurulent exudate with pus cells | coats the serosa.

segments.text: CT常见壁增厚强化、周围渗出明显，
segments.en: CT: thickened, enhancing wall; marked | surrounding exudation.

segments.text: 与管壁内外的炎症相互映照。
segments.en: matching inflammation in and around the | appendix.

segments.text: 终局黑：腔内压力升高，危机步步逼近。
segments.en: Final act, black: pressure inside rises.

segments.text: 血管受压或形成血栓，阑尾壁陷入缺血。
segments.en: Vessel compression or clots cause ischemia | of the appendiceal wall.

segments.text: 血流受阻，组织坏死，还伴有出血。
segments.en: Tissue dies, often with bleeding.

segments.text: 坏死与血红蛋白分解产物，
segments.en: Necrosis and hemoglobin breakdown products

segments.text: 让局部暗红，甚至发黑。
segments.en: can make the tissue dark red or black.

segments.text: 变质在这里走向重处：大片组织坏死。
segments.en: Alteration becomes severe: | extensive tissue necrosis.

segments.text: 它与渗出，共同写下急性期的病变。
segments.en: Alteration and exudation together mark | the acute phase.

segments.text: 这便是坏疽性阑尾炎。
segments.en: This is gangrenous appendicitis.

segments.text: 脆弱的管壁可能穿孔，让感染扩散至腹腔。
segments.en: The wall may perforate, spreading | infection into the abdomen.

segments.text: CT若见壁强化缺损，要警惕坏死；
segments.en: A wall enhancement defect on CT raises | concern for necrosis.

segments.text: 若见腔外气体、脓肿，更要警惕穿孔。[3]
segments.en: Extraluminal gas or an abscess raises | concern for perforation.

segments.text: 读懂分型，是为了把握治疗的紧迫性。
segments.en: Classification helps determine treatment | urgency.

segments.text: 最终分型，仍靠切除后的病理切片确认。
segments.en: The final type is confirmed by pathology | after removal.

segments.text: CT也帮助发现坏疽、穿孔、脓肿等并发症。[3][4]
segments.en: CT also helps detect gangrene, | perforation, and abscesses.

segments.text: 蜂窝织炎性、坏疽性需手术切除。[5]
segments.en: Suppurative (phlegmonous) and gangrenous | types require appendectomy.

segments.text: 面对病变，治疗要结合患者的具体情况。
segments.en: Treatment depends on the patient's | individual condition.

segments.text: 是否马上手术，由医生评估决定。
segments.en: Doctors assess how urgently surgery is | needed.

segments.text: 反复发作，可转为慢性阑尾炎。
segments.en: Repeated episodes may lead to chronic | appendicitis.

segments.text: 急性期以变质、渗出为主，
segments.en: The acute phase mainly involves | alteration and exudation;

segments.text: 转为慢性才出现增生。
segments.en: proliferation appears in the | chronic phase.

segments.text: 镜下可见阑尾壁纤维组织增生、纤维化，
segments.en: Microscopy shows fibrous tissue growth | and fibrosis in the appendiceal wall,

segments.text: 伴淋巴细胞、浆细胞等慢性炎细胞浸润。[2]
segments.en: with chronic inflammatory cells such as | lymphocytes and plasma cells.

segments.text: 转入慢性，并不意味着从此风平浪静。
segments.en: Chronic disease still carries risks.

segments.text: 疼痛即便时轻时重，也应接受正规评估。
segments.en: Even intermittent pain deserves proper | medical assessment.

segments.text: 一旦确诊，通常建议症状缓解期择期切除；
segments.en: Once diagnosed, elective appendectomy is | usually advised when symptoms settle;

segments.text: 若正处急性发作期，则视情况急诊手术。
segments.en: during an acute episode, emergency surgery | depends on the situation.

segments.text: 红、黄、黑，是洞察微观病变的罗盘，
segments.en: Red, yellow, and black are a compass | for understanding microscopic changes,

segments.text: 不是等待病情演进的时钟。别等病情加重，
segments.en: not a clock to wait by. | Do not wait for disease to worsen.

segments.text: 持续右下腹痛、发热，请及时就诊。
segments.en: Seek medical care for persistent lower | right abdominal pain or fever.
